name: Ajani, Sleeper Agent
oracle_text:
Compleated ({G/W/P} can be paid with {G}, {W}, or 2 life. If life was paid, this planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.)
+1: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature or planeswalker card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
−3: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among up to three target creatures. They gain vigilance until end of turn.
−6: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a creature or planeswalker spell, target opponent gets two poison counters."
blocked_sentences: Compleated ({G/W/P} can be paid with {G}, {W}, or 2 life. If life was paid, this planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.)
−3: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among up to three target creatures. They gain vigilance until end of turn.

needs.what: a planeswalker enters-with-loyalty replacement: if life was paid for any Phyrexian pip while casting it, it enters with two fewer loyalty counters (rule 702.150)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Casting already lets a Phyrexian pip be bought with 2 life (paying_phyrexian), but nothing records that life was paid for the cast spell and nothing reduces starting loyalty; no keyword, condition (cost_option/was_cast) or card-level key covers it

needs.what: place N +1/+1 counters divided as the controller chooses among up to N target creatures (each target gets at least one), with the division chosen on activation (rule 601.2d)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters takes one amount applied to every object it names; target_keys has count/up_to but no division; no op or decision distributes a total among targets
